sections.title: Front matter
sections.extract: THE HOLONOMY BRAIDING FOR Uξ(sl2) IN TERMS OF GEOMETRIC QUANTUM DILOGARITHMS CALVIN MCPHAIL-SNYDER AND NICOLAI RESHETIKHIN Abstract. We derive an explicit formula for the holonomy R-matrix of quantum sl2 at a root of unity. We show it factorizes into a product of four quantum dilogarithms and satisfies a holonomy Yang-Baxter equation. This factorization extends previously known results and we collect many existing
